name: PGS2SRT – Swift + MKVToolNix
install:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mkvtoolnix binutils git gnupg2 libc6-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libedit2 libgcc-13-dev libncurses6 libpython3-dev libsqlite3-dev libstdc++-13-dev libxml2-dev libz3-dev pkg-config tzdata unzip zlib1g-dev
if ! command -v swift >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://download.swift.org/swift-6.1-release/ubuntu2404/swift-6.1-RELEASE/swift-6.1-RELEASE-ubuntu24.04.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=2
fi
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/pgs2srt-uniMac' ] || (cd '/agent/repos/pgs2srt-uniMac' && swift build)
